arxiv-2210-00897.title: Hybrid magnetization dynamics in Cu 2 ​ OSeO 3 \text{Cu}_{\text{2}}\text{OSeO}_{\text{3}} /NiFe heterostructures
arxiv-2210-00897.creator: Carolina Lüthi ∗, Luis Flacke ∗, Aisha Aqeel, Akashdeep Kamra, Rudolf Gross, Christian Back, Mathias Weiler
arxiv-2210-00897.description: Abstract We investigate the coupled magnetization dynamics in heterostructures of a single crystal of the chiral magnet Cu 2 ​ OSeO 3 \mathrm{Cu_{2}OSeO_{3}} (CSO) and a polycrystalline ferromagnet NiFe \mathrm{NiFe} (Py) thin film using broadband ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) at cryogenic temperatures. We observe the excitation of a hybrid mode (HM) below the helimagnetic transition temperature of CSO.

arxiv-2210-13127.creator: Abhijeet Bishnu 1 , Ankit Gupta 2 , Mandar Gogate 3 , Kia Dashtipour 3 , Ahsan Adeel 4 , Amir Hussain 3 , Mathini Sellathurai 2 , and Tharmalingam Ratnarajah 1

Despite the innovative structures they develop to support the projects, OSS projects and their communities have complex needs and face risks such as getting abandoned.

arxiv-2304-05746.title: Quantifying the heterogeneous impact of lockdown policies on different socioeconomic classes during the first COVID-19 wave in Colombia
arxiv-2304-05746.creator: Pablo Valgañón, Andrés F. Useche, David Soriano-Paños, Gourab Ghoshal, Jesús Gómez-Gardeñes
arxiv-2304-05746.description: Abstract In the absence of vaccines, the most widespread reaction to curb COVID-19 pandemic worldwide was the implementation of lockdowns or stay-at-home policies. Despite the reported usefulness of such policies, their efficiency was highly constrained by socioeconomic factors determining their feasibility and their outcome in terms of mobility reduction and the subsequent limitation of social activity.

arxiv-2305-04094.title: Causal, Stochastic MPC for Wave Energy Converters
arxiv-2305-04094.creator: Connor H. Ligeikis, Jeffrey T. Scruggs
arxiv-2305-04094.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Connor H. Ligeikis, Jeffrey T. Scruggs. We implement a causal model predictive control (MPC) strategy to maximize power generation from a wave energy converter (WEC) system, for which the power take-off (PTO) systems have both hard stroke (i.e., displacement) limits and force ratings. The approach models the WEC dynamics in discrete-time, in a manner that exactly preserves energy-flow quantities, and assumes a stationary stochastic disturbance model for the incident wave force.

arxiv-2308-14739.title: Sharper dimension-free bounds on the Frobenius distance between sample covariance and its expectation
arxiv-2308-14739.creator: Nikita Puchkin, Fedor Noskov, Vladimir Spokoiny
arxiv-2308-14739.description: Abstract We study properties of a sample covariance estimate Σ ^ \widehat{\Sigma} given a finite sample of n n i.i.d. centered random elements in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} with the covariance matrix Σ \Sigma . We derive dimension-free bounds on the squared Frobenius norm of ( Σ ^ − Σ ) (\widehat{\Sigma}-\Sigma) under reasonable assumptions.

arxiv-2310-15003.title: Neural Snowflakes: Universal Latent Graph Inference via Trainable Latent Geometries
arxiv-2310-15003.creator: Haitz Sáez de Ocáriz BordeOxford Robotics InstituteUniversity of OxfordOxford, UK haitz@oxfordrobotics.institute, Anastasis KratsiosDepartment of MathematicsMcMaster University and the Vector InstituteOntario, Canada kratsioa@mcmaster.ca
arxiv-2310-15003.description: Abstract The inductive bias of a graph neural network (GNN) is largely encoded in its specified graph. Latent graph inference relies on latent geometric representations to dynamically rewire or infer a GNN’s graph to maximize the GNN’s predictive downstream performance, but it lacks solid theoretical foundations in terms of embedding-based representation guarantees.

arxiv-2403-04712.title: GMKF: Generalized Moment Kalman Filter for Polynomial Systems with Arbitrary Noise
arxiv-2403-04712.creator: Sangli Teng, Harry Zhang, David Jin, Ashkan Jasour, Maani Ghaffari, Luca Carlone
arxiv-2403-04712.description: Abstract This paper develops a new filtering approach for state estimation in polynomial systems corrupted by arbitrary noise, which commonly arise in robotics. We first consider a batch setup where we perform state estimation using all data collected from the initial to the current time.

arxiv-2503-18947.title: Tuning-Free Amodal Segmentation via the Occlusion-Free Bias of Inpainting Models
arxiv-2503-18947.creator: Jae Joong Lee, Bedrich Benes, Raymond A. Yeh
arxiv-2503-18947.description: Abstract Amodal segmentation aims to predict segmentation masks for both the visible and occluded regions of an object. Most existing works formulate this as a supervised learning problem, requiring manually annotated amodal masks or synthetic training data. Consequently, their performance depends on the quality of the datasets, which often lack diversity and scale.

arxiv-2505-07358.title: Two-point tree-level string amplitudes as AdS transition amplitudes
arxiv-2505-07358.creator: Pongwit Srisangyingcharoen, Jongruk Pukdee
arxiv-2505-07358.description: Abstract We compute the two-point open string and closed string amplitudes at tree level and show that, in a ’t Hooft-like limit, they take a form structurally analogous to boundary-to-boundary transition amplitudes of a scalar field in Euclidean AdS space.

arxiv-2602-06902.title: Parameter-free Dynamic Regret: Time-varying Movement Costs, Delayed Feedback, and Memory
arxiv-2602-06902.creator: Emmanuel Esposito, Andrew Jacobsen, Hao Qiu, Mengxiao Zhang
arxiv-2602-06902.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Emmanuel Esposito, Andrew Jacobsen, Hao Qiu, Mengxiao Zhang. In this paper, we study dynamic regret in unconstrained online convex optimization (OCO) with movement costs. Specifically, we generalize the standard setting by allowing the movement cost coefficients λ t \lambda_{t} to vary arbitrarily over time.

pmc-10512562.creator: Maryam Salem, Farnaz Khadivi, Parinaz Javanbakht, Sina Mojaverrostami, Mehdi Abbasi, Narjes Feizollahi, Yasaman Abbasi, Ehsan Heidarian, Farzane Rezaei Yazdi
pmc-10512562.description: The loss of germ cells and spermatogenic failure in non-obstructive azoospermia are believed to be the main causes of male infertility. Laboratory studies have used in vitro testicular models and different 3-dimensional (3D) culture systems for preservation, proliferation and differentiation of spermatogonial stem cells (SSCs) in recent decades.

pmc-11198349.title: LV Strain Superiority Over LVEF in HFmrEF
pmc-11198349.creator: Giuseppe Galati, Olga Germanova, Roberto Franco Enrico Pedretti
pmc-11198349.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Corresponding Author Heart failure (HF) affects 64 million people worldwide and represents the first cardiovascular (CV) cause of hospitalization and one of the most common causes of death carrying a prognosis worse than many cancers. Since 1991, when the SOLVD trial was published, a threshold of left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≤35% has been used to define HF with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF).

pmc-11444044.title: Air pollution below US regulatory standards and cardiovascular diseases using a double negative control approach
pmc-11444044.creator: Yichen Wang, Mahdieh Danesh Yazdi, Yaguang Wei, Joel D. Schwartz
pmc-11444044.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Growing evidence suggests that long-term air pollution exposure is a risk factor for cardiovascular mortality and morbidity. However, few studies have investigated air pollution below current regulatory limits, and causal evidence is limited. We use a double negative control approach to examine the association between long-term exposure to air pollution at low concentration and cardiovascular hospitalizations among US Medicare beneficiaries aged ≥65 years between 2000 and 2016.

pmc-11511319.title: Unraveling the Electrochemical Insights of Cobalt Oxide/Conducting Polymer Hybrid Materials for Supercapacitor, Battery, and Supercapattery Applications
pmc-11511319.creator: Annu, Sang-Shin Park, Md Najib Alam, Manesh Yewale, Dong Kil Shin, Vincenzo Baglio
pmc-11511319.description: This review article focuses on the potential of cobalt oxide composites with conducting polymers, particularly polypyrrole (PPy) and polyaniline (PANI), as advanced electrode materials for supercapacitors, batteries, and supercapatteries. Cobalt oxide, known for its high theoretical capacitance, is limited by poor conductivity and structural degradation during cycling.

pmc-11609373.title: Fragility of ER homeostatic regulation underlies haploid instability in human somatic cells
pmc-11609373.creator: Sumire Ishida-Ishihara, Kan Yaguchi, Sena Miura, Ryoto Nomura, QiJiao Wang, Koya Yoshizawa, Kimino Sato, Guang Yang, Krisztina Veszelyi, Gabor Banhegyi, Eva Margittai, Ryota Uehara
pmc-11609373.description: Mammalian somatic cells are generally unstable in the haploid state, resulting in haploid-to-diploid conversion within a short time frame. However, cellular and molecular principles that limit the sustainability of somatic haploidy remain unknown. In this study, we found the haploidy-linked vulnerability to endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress as a critical cause of haploid intolerance in human somatic cells.

pmc-11658054.title: Pheromone relay networks in the honeybee: messenger workers distribute the queen’s fertility signal throughout the hive
pmc-11658054.creator: Thomas O. Richardson, Tomas Kay, Laurent Keller, Nathalie Stroeymeyt
pmc-11658054.description: BackgroundThe harmonious operation of many insect societies depends upon colony-wide dissemination of a non-volatile pheromone produced by a single queen, which informs workers of her presence. This represents a major challenge in large colonies. Honeybee colonies, which can exceed 60,000 bees, are believed to solve this challenge using ‘messenger’ workers that actively relay the queen pheromone throughout the hive.

pmc-11733964.title: 30-Day and 1-Year Acute Myocardial Infarction Outcomes in Côte d'Ivoire
pmc-11733964.creator: Hermann Yao, Richie Kipenge, Arnaud Ekou, Esther Ehouman, Camille Toure, Isabelle Kouame, Elvis Sepih, Legre Vy, Roland N’Guetta
pmc-11733964.description: BackgroundWhereas the increasing burden of acute myocardial infarction (MI) has been reported in sub-Saharan Africa, little is known about short- and long-term prognosis following acute MI.ObjectivesThe purpose of this study was to assess in-hospital, 30-day, and 1-year all-cause mortality and adverse outcomes in patients with MI hospitalized at a cardiac center in Côte d’Ivoire.

pmc-12610390.title: Development of a Machine Learning Interatomic Potential for Zirconium and Its Verification in Molecular Dynamics
pmc-12610390.creator: Yuxuan Wan, Xuan Zhang, Liang Zhang, Mads Brandbyge
pmc-12610390.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Molecular dynamics (MD) can dynamically reveal the structural evolution and mechanical response of Zirconium (Zr) at the atomic scale under complex service conditions such as high temperature, stress, and irradiation. However, traditional empirical potentials are limited by their fixed function forms and parameters, making it difficult to accurately describe the multi-body interactions of Zr under conditions such as multi-phase structures and strong nonlinear deformation, thereby limiting the accuracy and generalization ability of simulation results.

pmc-13655604.description: Xylella fastidiosa is a plant-pathogenic bacterium that causes severe diseases in economically important crops, such as citrus and grapevine, thereby posing a significant threat to global agriculture.
